correctness.rationale: Integrating the standard skew Brownian heat kernel on [0,L] gives Sβ=A+βB; independent Bernoulli indicators yield Δβ=N Var_x(Sβ). Since B strictly decreases, Δ is strictly convex in β, while endpoint derivatives exclude any zero finite-time variance for all β. Separate Gaussian end layers yield the short-time clipped optimizer β→1. The compact-interval Gaussian expansion reduces leading long-time variance to Var((1+β)u²+(β-1)u)=(61β²+2β+1)/180; independent symbolic integration confirms this exact polynomial and unique β=-1/61, with coefficient ratio 60/61 relative to β=0 and 64 for β=1. Continuity gives at least one reversal, not uniqueness.
